settings.heading: What you are dealing with
settings.intro: Executives who come to a Sprint usually recognise most of these.
items: Other people's requests set your week. By Wednesday you have not worked on what you planned on Monday.
You do not know where your time goes. You are busy, but you cannot say how many hours go to email, preparation and reporting.
Information is scattered. The answer is in an email, a chat, a file or someone's head, and finding it takes time.
Reports are rebuilt every week or month. The same figures are collected and formatted by hand.
Long documents are read line by line. Contracts, proposals and board papers take hours of your attention.
Follow-ups slip. What was agreed in a meeting is not tracked until someone asks.
Your assistant spends time on work that could run without anyone. Scheduling, collecting, copying and chasing.
Tools were bought and not adopted. The licences are paid for, and your team uses a fraction of what they can do.
Delegating takes longer than doing it yourself. The instructions are not clear enough to hand over.
Decisions wait for analysis. A question that needs data takes days to answer.
The same process runs three different ways. Each person does it differently, and the quality varies.
You cannot step away. A week off means a backlog when you return.

settings.heading: At the end of the week you have
settings.intro: The tasks depend on your work. We choose them together on day 1, from what the analysis shows.

items.title: A written baseline
items.text: On day 1 we record how many hours a week you spend on your main recurring tasks. We measure again on day 5 and on day 30.

items.title: Your biggest tasks improved
items.text: Three to five recurring tasks. Some run on their own, such as weekly reports, meeting briefs and follow-up tracking. Others are faster because you or your assistant follow a documented AI procedure.

items.title: Training on your own tasks
items.text: You and your assistant practise on real work, not examples.

items.title: A playbook
items.text: One document that lists what runs, who owns it and how to change it.

items.title: Confidentiality rules
items.text: For your tools and data, written for your situation.

items.title: 14 days of support
items.text: By message after the Sprint ends.

settings.heading: Your Monday is held once payment arrives.
Five working days, Monday to Friday
settings.intro: Your time is 45 minutes a day, plus a few minutes each day to review what I send. That is about 5 hours in total, less than one working day spread across a week. The Monday after, your week runs on the new setup.

items.title: Day 1
items.text: Session: we map your week, record the baseline and agree the target. Between sessions: I analyse your tasks and tools.

items.title: Day 2
items.text: Session: we choose the tasks to improve and set the confidentiality rules. Between sessions: I design the changes.

items.title: Day 3
items.text: Session: you review the first automations. Between sessions: I build and test them.

items.title: Day 4
items.text: Session: we run them on live work. Between sessions: I fix what the live run shows.

items.title: Day 5
items.text: Session: you and your assistant take over. Between sessions: I write the playbook.

settings.heading: A measured result, built by me

items.title: I build it
items.text: The result does not depend on how much time you have to learn.

items.title: A written target
items.text: On day 1 we agree how many hours a week should come back and how we will measure it. I do not agree to a target I do not think is reachable.

items.title: Nothing waits more than a day
items.text: You have a 45-minute session each day. Between sessions I analyse, build and test, and you review by message.

items.title: Your tasks, your tools
items.text: I work inside what you already use. You do not get a standard package.

items.title: Limited places
items.text: I limit the number of Sprints each month, so each one gets my full attention.

items.title: Support after the last session
items.text: It continues for 14 days, so problems that appear in week two are fixed.

settings.heading: Is AI Sprint right for you?
settings.intro: AI Sprint is for executives who want the work done for them: CEOs, managing directors, founders, partners, senior directors and business owners. Many clients start with an AI Jump, but it is not required.
left_items: You can name the tasks that eat your week, such as email, reporting, meeting preparation or follow-ups
You can give me access to the tools and files involved
You can spare 45 minutes a day for five days
You want a result that is measured, not a feeling that things are better
settings.right_title: This is not for you if
right_items: You cannot give access to your tools
You want no involvement at all, because I need your decisions during the week

settings.heading: Thirty more days at no charge
settings.text: On day 1 we write down your baseline and an agreed target for hours returned each week. If the target is not met by day 30, measured the same way as the baseline, I keep working with you at no charge for up to 30 more days or until we achieve the agreed baseline.
points: You give me the access I ask for within 24 hours
You use the setup as we agreed
The target is set honestly on day 1

items.q: How much of my time does it take?
items.a: 45 minutes a day for five days, plus a few minutes each day to approve or correct what I send you by message. About 5 hours in total.

items.q: Do I need to learn any tool?
items.a: No. You do not need to read documentation or build anything. I do the analysis, the building and the testing.
Access to the tools and files involved, within 24 hours of my asking. Your assistant joins the day 5 session, if you have one.

items.q: Do I need an AI Jump first?
items.a: No. Many clients start with a Jump, and its fee is credited in full if you book the Sprint within 7 days.

Every Sprint starts on a Monday, with a maximum of 4 a month. Your Monday is held once payment arrives. Dates that are not paid for are released on the Friday before and offered to the next person in line.
AI Quest, a monthly seat for keeping your setup current. Your Quest seat is held for 7 days after your last Sprint session.
